steps.pseudocode: Take two vectors of the same length, u and v.

steps.label: Compute the dot product
steps.pseudocode: Multiply matching entries and add the results.

steps.label: Vectors pointing the same way
steps.pseudocode: When two vectors point the same way, the dot product is large and positive.

steps.pseudocode: If the dot product of two non-zero vectors is zero, they are orthogonal.

steps.label: Read coordinates independently
steps.pseudocode: With perpendicular directions, each coordinate is a separate dot product. Nothing overlaps.
